rootProject.name = "urbo-cms"

pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        // Build-logic plugins (io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.*) are resolved from the public,
        // read-only S3 maven repo — no credentials required.
        maven {
            url = uri("https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases")
            mavenContent {
                includeGroupByRegex("io\\.swcode.*")
            }
        }
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
    }
}

plugins {
    // Apply the foojay-resolver plugin to allow automatic download of JDKs
    id("org.gradle.toolchains.foojay-resolver-convention") version "1.0.0"
    id("de.fayard.refreshVersions") version "0.60.6"
}

refreshVersions {
    rejectVersionIf {
        candidate.stabilityLevel.isLessStableThan(de.fayard.refreshVersions.core.StabilityLevel.Stable)
    }
}

include(
    "urbo-account-api",
    "urbo-app",
    "urbo-authorization-api",
    "urbo-casbin",
    "urbo-catalog",
    "urbo-change-request",

    "urbo-core-starter",

===
plugins {
    // 1.0.56 flips detekt to enforcing — the classpath-free `detekt` task now fails
    // `check`/`build`, and the type-resolution `detektMain`/`detektTest` analysis is
    // enforced via the CI `reportMerge` step (findings cleared in #6396 + #6398);
    // 1.0.54 drops the deprecated `by registering` delegate for the reportMerge task;
    // 1.0.53 fixes detekt's Kotlin-classpath pin + reads the per-repo `detekt.yml`
    // from the Gradle root; 1.0.52 flips ktlint to enforcing (ktlintCheck now fails
    // the build); 1.0.51 adds detekt (warning-only, `dev.detekt` 2.0.0-alpha.5) with
    // the SARIF `reportMerge` task; 1.0.49 sets the JDK 25 toolchain centrally;
    // 1.0.48 dropped org.sonarqube and added ktlint in the urbo-build convention plugin.
    id("io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project") version "1.0.56"

    // Applied at the root, where `cyclonedxBom` aggregates every subproject into one
    // document. Left at its defaults deliberately: the plugin's configuration API has
    // moved across majors, and the defaults already write build/reports/bom.json.
    id("org.cyclonedx.bom") version "3.4.1"
}===
FROM amazoncorretto:25
ENV APP_NAME=urbo-cms

EXPOSE 8080

ADD https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases/download/v2.11.0/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar /opentelemetry-javaagent.jar

COPY urbo-app/build/libs/urbo-app.jar /app.jar

ENV SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod
ENV SERVICE_NAME=urbco-cms-backend
ENV NAMESPACE=urbo

ENV JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-javaagent:/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar -Dotel.resource.attributes=service.name=$SERVICE_NAME -Dotel.resource.attributes.deployment.environment=$SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE -Dotel.resource.attributes.service.namespace=$NAMESPACE"

ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app.jar"]

observation.command: cd /workspace; cat backend/settings.gradle.kts; echo ===; sed -n '1,80p' backend/build.gradle.kts; echo ===; cat backend/Dockerfile
